name: Elman
source:
The owner of the only alchemy shop in Ethger's outskirts, he has to manage it on his own due to his partner leaving the business. Despite barely being able to keep up with mountains of urgent orders, he still finds the time for people he cares about.
Houses a couple of basilisks and a kyris bird, explaining his great amount of scars by their mischief, but is it really true?
